title: Entering the Cave
shot: medium from behind, entering the dark
camera: push forward following behind KAIRO into darkness
action: KAIRO rushes into the cave, stumbles on loose stone and catches his balance. Bright sunlight stays behind him as the camera follows him into the dark.
expression: relief mixed with panic, one quick backward glance
lighting: hard sunlight wedge on the floor, deep black beyond
audio: running footsteps become echoing steps, tight breathing, cave reverb
dialogue_fa: خودمو پرت کردم توی غار... و فقط امیدوار بودم اون موجود دنبالم نیاد.
gloss_en: I threw myself into the cave... just hoping that creature wouldn't follow me.
continuity: same cave mouth geometry as S12
transition: his backward glance sets up the reverse angle of S14
image_prompt: Interior of a cave mouth seen from just inside. KAIRO the stickman in a hide tunic stumbles forward into the dark, arms out for balance, spear still in one hand. A hard wedge of golden sunlight falls across the rocky floor behind him; the passage ahead is black. 2D cinematic animation, dust particles in the light beam, deep shadow.
